high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot from an Instagram post by Kylie Jenner, as indicated by the username "kyliejenner" at the top left corner of the image. The post was made 14 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The setting is a luxurious bedroom with an ornate bed. The bed features a large, elaborate headboard with intricate carvings and a floral pattern in shades of yellow and white. The bed is dressed with white sheets and pillows, and there are two large, plush pillows with a greenish-yellow pattern on either side of the bed.
